newsitem.title: JAPAN: IDC subsidiaries to lease international call lines.
newsitem.headline: IDC subsidiaries to lease international call lines.

text.p: Japan's International Digital Communications Inc (IDC) said on Friday that its wholly-owned subsidiary, IDC America Inc, has obtained U.S. approval to lease international phone lines to corporate customers.
The leasing service also requires a government licence in Japan. IDC said that its Japanese subsidiary, IDC Solutions Inc, is expected to obtain government approval shortly.
The service will lower the cost for customers leasing phone lines, an IDC official said.
